north_star: Preserve a replayable record of both industrial reality and point-in-time expectations.
Standing at a historical date, future information published later must remain unavailable.
Prefer traceable and semantically comparable trajectories over a large pile of shallow snippets.

strategic_horizon.current_big_goal: Prove Longcycle end-to-end on the lithium value chain: archived evidence must support point-in-time Reality + Expectation + Outcome replay across a real cycle, not merely a large Memory Atlas or sophisticated platform.
strategic_horizon.current_phase_purpose: Use blind high-capability Memory Atlas exhaustion to reduce historical coverage gaps that ordinary web retrieval would miss, then measure novelty decay so the work can legitimately exit recall and enter evidence recovery.
strategic_horizon.next_big_step: Seal the first genuinely saturated high-value shard(s), let the high-capability model perform self-verification/search discovery, compile claim-scoped evidence tasks for lower-capability agents, archive original sources, and begin the first real Reality/Expectation/Outcome historical replay.
strategic_horizon.parallel_permanent_track: Maintain source-first/archive-now current collection so today's original disclosures do not become tomorrow's historical-recovery gaps.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Stop or re-rank a local engineering/research task when another coherent batch no longer materially improves coverage, evidence traceability, point-in-time replay, or a blocker on that path; do not optimize lead count, generic infrastructure, CI/handoff polish, or ontology for its own sake.

non_negotiable_invariants: Model memory is a search lead, never Evidence, Fact or Judgment.
Blind memory shards must seal before fresh web self-verification can begin.
Raw blind-recall artifacts are immutable; schema-only corrections use explicit typed repair overlays.
Reality, Expectation/Judgment and later Outcome remain distinguishable.
valid_time and known_time must not be collapsed.
Comparability semantics are required before corroboration or conflict decisions.
Current source material should be archived proactively and historical versions must not be overwritten.
State authority must distinguish canonical/immutable, deterministic-derived, curated research assessment and narrative state.
Immediate TODOs are subordinate to STRATEGIC_COMPASS.md and the lithium end-to-end replay benchmark.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not start fresh web research on an unsealed blind shard.
Do not convert repeated web syndication or search rank into truth.
Do not overwrite raw model recall to make validation pass.
Do not seal a shard merely because the model says it has nothing else to recall.
Do not trust stale chat summaries, PR prose or checkpoint CI status without refreshing live GitHub state.
Do not describe curated novelty/gap judgments as deterministic facts merely because they are stored in JSON.
Do not ask the user to reconstruct project context already persisted in the repository.
Do not let Memory Atlas volume, generic platform construction, schema perfection, lint cleanup, handoff refinement or one-domain depth become the product objective.
future_phase_commitments: Historical recovery remains memory-first and evidence-final.
After a shard seals, the high-capability model performs the first self-verification/search pass before lower-capability evidence agents are delegated work.
Lower-capability agents are evidence engineers following explicit source, search-depth, contradiction and stop-condition contracts; they do not publish cycle conclusions.
Bridge/satellite promotion depends on repeated independent triggers rather than a single shard tangent.
Current collection remains source-first/archive-now under a maintained source/watchlist discipline.
A stronger model vintage creates a new immutable Memory Atlas vintage; diff novel/refined leads into historical backfill tasks instead of overwriting prior recall.
After the lithium benchmark can perform evidence-backed point-in-time replay, extract only the primitives proven by that benchmark and validate portability on a second industry.

memory_campaign.seal_rule: A shard may seal only after three consecutive low-novelty batches plus a negative-space/gap-matrix review with no material uncovered dimension.
next_research_actions: Rebuild deterministic compact indices for all 14 primary shards from typed/repaired blind JSONL.
Rank batch3 candidates by importance, unresolved gap density and semantic coverage rather than raw shard size.
For each selected batch3, classify outputs as new_category, useful_refinement or duplicate and measure novelty decay.
Keep search_visibility=none until an individual shard satisfies the seal rule.
